english.title: Fail to comply with the restrictions concerning the placement of animals or products on the market or for export
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person with animals placed under an official movement restriction, failed to comply with the restrictions in Annex 8 of the EU TSE Regulation and Schedule 8 to the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (England) Regulations 2018, concerning the placement of animals or products on the market or for export, in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(6)(g) and 18(1)(a) and (2) of the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (England) Regulations 2018.
